# Stem Lab

> Stem Lab is a free, open-source stem splitter for Apple Silicon Macs. It
> splits any song into four stems: vocals, drums, bass and other.

The app is a single macOS download. Drop a song on it; the stems land in a
folder next to the original file. No account, no upload, no cost.

## What it does

- Splits a song into vocals.wav, drums.wav, bass.wav and other.wav.
- Vocals come from a Mel-Band Roformer model. Drums, bass and other come from
  htdemucs_ft. Both models run in parallel and the best output wins per stem.
- Accepts wav, mp3, flac and m4a input.
- A 4-minute song takes about 5 minutes to process.

## Requirements

- Apple Silicon Mac (M1 or newer), macOS 13 or later.
- Runs entirely on the Mac's own GPU. Fully offline: no uploads, no account,
  no telemetry.

## Cost and licence

- Free. Current release is v1.3.0, a 1.3 GB DMG.
- Open source under the MIT licence.
- The app is unsigned, so macOS requires "Open Anyway" in
  System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
